exposure: Preoperative anxiety (measured on a verbal numerical scale)
outcome: Incidence of intraoperative pain during cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia
cohort: 193 parturients undergoing spinal anesthesia for elective cesarean delivery
finding: The study found a substantial incidence (11.9%) of intraoperative pain during cesarean delivery under spinal anesthesia, and preoperative anxiety was not a good predictor of this pain.
